admissions.excerpt: British Columbia College of Nurses and Midwives (BCCNM) Registration Requirements Once you graduate from the Bachelor of Science in Nursing program, you must apply for registration as a Registered Nurse with the BCCNM to be eligible for employment. To register you must meet the BCCNM Competencies and Standards for Entry-Level Registered Nurse Practice in British Columbia. completion.excerpt: Our grads are ready Recruiters know BCIT Nursing graduates succeed. Our students graduate with the expertise and capabilities to work in a multitude of healthcare settings across BC. Apply for your RN designation Grads are required to write the National Council Licensure Examinations for Registered Nurses (NCLEX-RN) to earn their Registered Nurse (RN) designation for licensure. The designation has yearly renewal fees and quality assurance guidelines. Visit the British Columbia College of Nurses
